data.body: 2026-05-12 update: Bug 583b-5e77 (committed cf878bde16) addresses the root guidance gaps diagnosed here: (1) caller-input verification gate prevents hallucinated reachability claims, (2) arithmetic verification gate prevents path/count errors, (3) tautological-assertion simulation prevents false tautology findings, (4) unverified-claim critical inflation rule prevents fragile/critical severity on unverified claims, (5) defense injection for local cycle-N re-reviews prevents stale findings from resurfacing. These 5 gates directly address Examples 1, 2, 3, and 4 in this ticket. Remaining gaps from fix sketch: (3b) context window for hunk-only dispatch and (3c) post-review verifier sub-agent are architectural — require a new epic. Marking this ticket for re-evaluation after next CI review cycle to confirm improvement rate.
